card.name: Pain in the CABG NSAID warning
card.fires_on: The word "pain" right after "treatment of" (or "peri-operative") in the NSAID warning about coronary artery bypass graft surgery. It responds to this one boilerplate sentence.

modes.label: Pain after CABG trials
modes.description: "pain" ends the phrase "treatment of pain" in the CABG trial sentence for COX-2 NSAIDs.
modes.example: Two large, controlled clinical trials of a COX-2 selective NSAID for the treatment of<< pain>> in the first 10-1

modes.label: Peri-operative pain
modes.description: "pain" follows "peri-operative" in a CABG contraindication statement.
modes.example: Salsalate tablets, USP are contraindicated for the treatment of peri-operative<< pain>> in the setting of coronary artery bypass graft

card.writes: The promoted tokens are unrelated, and the suppressed ones are wound and injury words (including Chinese terms), so it mostly steers away from wound or injury words after "pain".
card.plain: It lights up on the word "pain" in the standard warning about NSAIDs used around heart bypass surgery.
